---
title: "Shiny App"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{app}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

<style>
/* Fill everything below the site navbar with the app and stop the page
   itself from scrolling; the app manages its own scrolling internally.
   The frame top is set from the real navbar height by the script below
   (fallback 56px), so it works when the navbar wraps on small screens. */
body {
  overflow: hidden;
}
.shiny-app-frame {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  top: var(--shiny-frame-top, 56px);
}
.shiny-app-frame iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: none;
}
</style>

<div class="shiny-app-frame">
<iframe src="https://milanwiedemann.shinyapps.io/opencodecounts/" title="opencodecounts Shiny app">
</iframe>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  function setFrameTop() {
    var nav = document.querySelector("nav.navbar");
    var top = nav ? Math.max(nav.getBoundingClientRect().bottom, 0) : 56;
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--shiny-frame-top", top + "px");
  }
  setFrameTop();
  window.addEventListener("resize", setFrameTop);
})();
</script>
